articles.title: At 76, PM Narendra Modi’s journey runs from a Gujarat town to the world stage
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi marked his 76th birthday on Thursday, September 17. This occasion reflects his remarkable political journey, originating from Vadnagar, Gujarat, and culminating in his tenure as India's highest elected official. His career exemplifies a long and dedicated path in public service, reaching the nation's top leadership position.

articles.title: We have an El Niño tracker in space but the rainfall reshapers we need to study most are closer home
articles.summary: Food prices are rising across the nation amidst weakening monsoon rains, resulting in a significant 15% rain deficit. This deficit is directly contributing to price uptrends for crucial commodities like oilseeds, edible oils, and pulses. The situation underscores a pressing national challenge concerning agricultural output and inflation, potentially impacting food security and household budgets.

articles.title: Modi and Xi’s Meeting Caps a Detente
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a significant meeting on the sidelines of the BRICS summit. Highlighted in Foreign Policy's South Asia Brief, this encounter is crucial for understanding current India-China relations and regional geopolitical dynamics. Such high-level engagements often signal shifts in international diplomacy, making them important for aspirants studying global affairs and foreign policy.

articles.title: Psychedelic Pop Artist Peter Max Has Died At 88, His Son Says
articles.summary: Peter Max, the renowned pop artist celebrated for his vibrant, psychedelic works emblematic of the 1960s flower power movement, has passed away at 86. His distinctive art, which captured the optimism of a generation, transcended traditional canvases, adorning everything from postage stamps to cruise ships, leaving an indelible mark on global culture.
